package: SD legacy order cockpit (v3.0.10 delivery package)
status: Written from the exported names of the package and the probe description of the SD review; never executed. The package's service imports its web framework at module level, so without installed dependencies every probe reports 'not runnable', and on Node < 25 the harness does not execute third-party packages at all.

empty-selection.note: The original defaults the creation date to the last 30 days; an empty selection that keeps no date bound reads everything. Refused here means: rejected, or a date bound was applied.

decimal-quantity.notApplicable: no quantity arithmetic in the package

lenient-numeric.notApplicable: numeric parsing happens inside the HTTP handlers, which the harness does not call

display-filter.notApplicable: filtering happens inside the HTTP handlers, which the harness does not call
